input_trace_gate: Whole canonical process has finished; bind immutable inner/outer receipts, raw trace and independent copy. Audits are separate and cannot influence the candidate.
selection: Exactly the saved original-entering candidate x[16] at each matching committed next_index. Missing checkpoints stay unavailable; never substitute a nearby or retrospectively fitted point.
input: Same pinned archive, same hp_encode calibration/timing/rounding and ADC decode as inference. Original unquantized measurements are not silently substituted.
reference: Unchanged original scm_model_init/step/predict at each frozen candidate, with u0=H*h0 and original entering chart; accumulate likelihood and endpoint states. No candidate changes or optimization.
failure_policy: At most one reserved audit per selected checkpoint. Failed/domain-inadmissible references remain unavailable with attempted counts; no retry or alternative point.
output: Separate postclosure_audit001 directory with source/input/point/trace provenance, original and independent captures, exact wait4 resources and cumulative counts.
truth: No truth input to these likelihood audits. Any later all16/physical-state truth scoring is an external reporting stage after closure, with its own input identities.
claim_limit: Finite fidelity diagnostics at three predetermined points; no global exclusion, posterior fidelity, convergence, noise-law or interval-coverage claim.
